objective: Production-ready English-first Sahih al-Bukhari reader with the full collection, precise source access, Cedar narration, whole-hadith sessions and dependable offline iPhone use.

decisions.search: Exact words/phrases and reference numbers first; no semantic topics or inferred summaries.
decisions.personalData: Downloadable local backup first. No accounts or cross-device server needed.
decisions.content: Keep raw Arabic, published translation, narration script and generated speech as separately versioned artifacts. Translation and audio approvals must identify the exact text hashes reviewed.
decisions.numbering: Namespace source IDs and edition references. Never assume one edition's book or hadith number equals another's.
decisions.architecture: Keep the static PWA. Split collection metadata, book text packs, search index and audio packs; load text and download audio independently. Preserve the persistent media element and waiting-worker update behavior.
decisions.publication: Candidate import is not reader approval. Resolve source coverage and rights, then review complete narrator chains, narration, chapter context and any source notes separately. Preserve repeated narrations; do not deduplicate by meaning.
decisions.browsing: Browsing outside the current session leaves its plan and continuation point intact. Only Start a session here, Next session, or an explicit restart replaces/restarts the plan; the user confirmed this on 18 October 2026.
decisions.offline: All available reading text, source notes and artwork saved together; choose Cedar audio separately. Optional delivery comparison recordings remain a separate choice. User selected this on 20 October 2026.
decisions.inheritedChainContext: A brief note above the text, explicitly separate from the hadith wording, with a link that opens the previous narrator chain. User selected this on 20 October 2026.
decisions.prototype: User chose a clearly labelled personal prototype on 20 October 2026. AI-assisted entries may be evaluated with transparent source decisions; this is not independent certification or permission to claim production accuracy.
decisions.chapterMaterial: Daily sessions contain numbered hadith only. Chapter introductions and quotations are available separately when browsing. User confirmed this on 20 October 2026.
decisions.printedSupplementReference: User confirmed app reference 724b with printed reference 758 kept accessible. Existing links and bookmarks remain stable; translation and source review remain separate.
decisions.sessionAdditions: User selected: keep the saved session intact and show a newly available report separately. Original ordered entries, cursor and finished state persist; separate links do not replace Continue. Pending references are preserved in new session state and backups.
